mods.name: Z_Diezel's Advanced Orbital Exchange Interface
mods.author: Z_Diezel
mods.description: An Orbital Exchange Interface that is able to direct the exchange pods to an exact location. Requires the T2 Orbital Exchange Interface talent. Crafted at the Fabricator. This version does NOT require electricity. (The asset mesh exists in the game files. I built the necessary data around it, and made the uasset icon. A future Icarus update may change the blueprint, so I left it as it is for now.)

mods.name: Z_Diezel's Cryo-canister
mods.author: Z_Diezel
mods.description: A portable ice-infused elanthium cryogenic canister to keep perishables from spoiling. Crafted at the Fabricator from 8 Iron Ingot, 10 Aluminum Ingot, 3 Carbon Paste, 10 Exotics, and 18 Ice. Has 10 slots.
